name: profile-only gate: a role-less USER principal is confined to /auth/*, /portal/*, and GET /api/me
why: portal-apps.md §6/§9.9: the gate is a filter installed immediately after authentication, ahead of every /api/* and /bff/* handler's own check — several of those handlers had no permission check at all before this filter existed, and an anchor-tier short-circuit used to let a zero-role ANCHOR user through almost everything. A wire diff here would mean the filter either over-blocks (breaking the profile page for every real user) or under-blocks (reopening the gap the spec closes).

steps.why: a plain POST /api/principals with no roles field and no subsequent role assignment: role-less by construction (spec §6: 'role-less ⇔ type is USER and roles are empty and permissions are empty').
the harness's cookie jar now carries this principal's session for every unauthenticated-looking step below (parity-harness.md §3: 'a jar per side').
spec §9.9: a role-less CLIENT-scoped user gets 403 NO_PLATFORM_ROLE (the exact envelope) on /bff/roles.
spec §9.9/§6 allowlist: GET /api/me passes — the one /api/* route the profile page itself calls.
hand the session back to the anchor admin before the anchor-role-less and confinement checks below, which need to create/assign roles.

spec §9.9: 'a role-less … ANCHOR user' also gets 403 — the gate is keyed on roles/permissions, never on anchor-domain membership (the pre-existing bug this filter closes: a zero-role ANCHOR user's tier short-circuit let it through almost everything). `scope: ANCHOR` (UserScopeDerivation) needs an anchor-domain email; `example.com` is `${admin.email}`'s own domain (`parity-admin@example.com`, parity-harness.md §2), the anchor domain the bootstrap admin lives in.
spec §9.9: the role-less ANCHOR user, not just the role-less CLIENT one, is refused — the anchor-tier short-circuit this filter closes.

spec §6: 'Pass through untouched: … SERVICE principals' — a client_credentials access token's `type` claim is SERVICE (auth-core.md), never gated here (it authorizes through its applications claim, not roles); this pins that the filter does not accidentally start gating service/application bearers. `provisionApplicationServiceAccount` (below) is the only way to mint a client_credentials-capable OAuth client — a plain POST /api/oauth-clients has no linked principal and the token endpoint refuses it (OAuthTokenApi: 'Client is not configured for this grant').
a SERVICE bearer reaching a route the USER gate above refused — proof the gate is principal-type-scoped, not path-scoped.

spec §6: 'Pass through untouched: unauthenticated requests (handlers apply their own checks)' — no bearer, no cookie; the 401 below comes from the route's own authenticator requirement, not NO_PLATFORM_ROLE.
the anchor admin (roles non-empty) is never role-less — sanity check that the gate above was specific to the role-less principal, not a blanket refusal of /bff/roles.
